script_text: Mars, your ruling planet, squares Saturn this week, Aries — expect friction wherever your cardinal fire energy clashes with resistance. By Thursday, Venus enters Leo and floods your 5th House with romantic energy, shifting the entire mood. The weekend brings a Moon in Sagittarius activating your 3rd House — conversations with siblings or neighbors carry surprising weight. Thursday is your worst day because Mars squares Saturn, blocking career momentum and testing your patience. Take bold action on Wednesday and let the rest unfold. Follow for daily updates.
